title: STAND-Guard: A Small Task-Adaptive Content Moderation Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance (F1 score) for detecting stereotypes and discrimination using prompt guidelines on datasets like CrowS-Pairs, DecodingTrust, and PKU-Alignment BeaverTails.
Measuring classification performance (F1 scores) for detecting sexist and misogynistic content using datasets such as CallMeSexist, SWSR, and ToLD-BR.
Evaluating the model's zero-shot classification F1 score for identifying racist content using the ToLD-BR dataset.
Measuring the F1 score for classifying homophobic text in a zero-shot setting using the ToLD-BR dataset.
